desc:
Airport Simulator is currently in early alpha, so you may experience occasional bugs or glitches during gameplay.

✈️ Welcome to Airport Simulator, a realistic airport experience where you can take on various roles that keep operations running smoothly.

Take on multiple roles such as:

Pilot – Fly aircraft and manage flight procedures.
Check-In Staff – Assist passengers and handle ticketing and boarding.
Ground Crew – Service aircraft, guide planes, and manage ground operations.

All roles can be unlocked for free!

[KEYWORDS] Airport Simulator, Flight Simulator, cabin crew, airport roleplay, ground crew, iloilo airport
